headline: Pavol's rule for all quiz apps is live. Every answer counts when given; a new practice set skips answered questions, apart from at most 40% due review. A lesson or practice round left early waits on home with Pokračovat / Nový trénink and resumes at the first unanswered question. Streak and lesson_complete count only a finished round. An exam left early keeps its answers and records no attempt.

shipped.title: Unfinished round: answers count when given, the round waits on home
shipped.live_checked: Deployed as f3babd0, bundle index-JBMCjH-L.js. Checked live in Chromium at 390 px with a cs-CZ locale and Supabase blocked. Answered 8 of 12 in the daily lesson (form B), pressed End, reloaded: home shows 'Rozpracovaný trénink · Dnešní lekce · 8 / 12' with Pokračovat and Nový trénink. scrollWidth 390, so there is no horizontal scroll. Pokračovat opened at 09 / 12, on the same question that was ninth before leaving, with the form-B box shown. Streak stayed at 0.

decisions.question: Language of the two labels
options: English only, like the rest of home
decisions.default_taken: Browser language, as the reasoning tests do: CS 'Pokračovat / Nový trénink', SK 'Pokračovať / Nový tréning', EN 'Continue / New round'. The rest of home stays English.
decisions.why: The orchestrator's brief asked for CS/SK/EN labels, and the reasoning tests already pick their language this way. The strings are one table in src/components/UnfinishedRound.tsx.

decisions.question: Which rounds wait on home
decisions.why: Review and bookmarks rounds work the same way as practice rounds. One line in RESUMABLE_MODES.

decisions.question: How many unfinished rounds
decisions.default_taken: One slot. Nový trénink replaces it, and so does another non-exam round from its first answer. A round opened and left unanswered keeps it, and so does the exam.
decisions.why: One card on home. The independent review found that a round opened without an answer wiped the waiting one; fixed before merge.

decisions.question: Practice set after the rule
options: unseen plus at most 40% due review
decisions.default_taken: Unseen plus at most 40% due review, the same share as the daily lesson. A search serves every match because it is a lookup. A filter with nothing unanswered serves the whole pool again.
decisions.why: Rule 1 says a new set skips what was answered. The two exceptions keep the button from serving nothing, or from hiding the question someone searched for.

decisions.question: Exam simulation draw
decisions.why: The rule covers an exam left early, not how the exam is drawn. Whether a mock should prefer unseen questions is listed under proposals.

decisions.question: Reasoning tests left early
options: treat as a timed sitting, like the exam
decisions.default_taken: Treated as a timed sitting: no resume and no score when left, which is the behaviour already in place.
decisions.why: They are timed like the real test, and resuming would leave the timer meaningless. Their answers aren't stored anywhere.

decisions.question: Question first and the commonplace book on resume
decisions.default_taken: The resumed question starts fresh in the chosen form (A/B/C). Answer options are fixed A–D, so their order never changes. Commonplace entries already save the moment they're collected.
decisions.why: Only answered questions are kept, and an unanswered question has nothing to restore.

decisions.question: Analytics for resume
decisions.default_taken: key_action {action: 'round_resume', mode, answered, total}. Nový trénink sends the usual start_*.
decisions.why: The brief asked for no new event names.

proposals.title: Exam simulation from unseen questions first
proposals.why: SIGNATURE.md says a mock built from questions already seen is not evidence. Rule 1 ('a new set skips what was answered') could extend to the exam draw: unseen first, topped up from the rest when a category runs out.
proposals.cost: Small: buildExam takes progress, plus a test.
